incidents.name: BlueHammer: Microsoft Defender elevation of privilege
incidents.summary: TOCTOU in Defender signature updates. Proof of concept published 2 Apr 2026, patched 14 Apr, added to the CISA catalog 22 Apr.

incidents.name: RoguePlanet: Microsoft Defender elevation of privilege
incidents.summary: Race condition in mpengine.dll, disclosed 9 Jun 2026 and fixed in engine 1.1.26060.3008.

incidents.name: ShieldBreak: Microsoft Defender elevation of privilege
incidents.summary: Public exploit released 11 Aug 2026 against the malware protection engine. Microsoft shipped a fix on 3 Sep.

incidents.name: ShieldCrash: Defender arbitrary file read (no CVE)
incidents.summary: Reported 8 Sep 2026 as a bypass of the ShieldBreak fix. Microsoft has not assigned a separate CVE. Reported by news, not confirmed by Microsoft.
